text: What if your body temperature started rising, and never stopped?
You feel totally fine. Everything around you... doesn't.
Forty-five degrees. Your ice cream gives up instantly.
One hundred. Every drop of sweat boils. You're a walking kettle.
Two hundred thirty-three. Paper bursts into flames. Your homework? Gone.
Five hundred twenty-five. You start to glow. Dull red, like a stove.
Six sixty. Aluminum melts. Soda cans just... drip.
Fifteen hundred. Steel melts. You lean on a car, and sink right into it.
Thirty-four hundred. Hotter than a light bulb filament. The whole street can see you.
Fifty-five hundred. The surface of the Sun. You are now a tiny star.
And your mom still tells you to bring a jacket.
